artworks.title: Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: The moment the old couple see leaves sprouting from each other's limbs — oak and linden guarding the temple ever after.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Mercury in the House of Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: Jordaens fills the cottage with Flemish abundance as the disguised gods accept the meal — Ovid's hospitality as festive welcome.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Mercury in the House of Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: Elsheimer's candlelit hut: Zeus and Hermes inside the thatched home — kindness painted as intimate German Baroque drama.

artworks.title: Philémon et Baucis
artworks.description: Déchenaud's academic canvas returns the Phrygian hosts to their table — twentieth-century reception of Ovid's rewarded piety.

music.title: Philémon et Baucis
music.description: Gounod's opéra-comique stages the cottage visit of Jupiter and Mercury — Ovid's hospitality myth as Second Empire theatre.

popCulture.title: Baucis and Philemon
popCulture.description: The poor Phrygian hosts of Zeus and Hermes remain Ovid's emblem of hospitality rewarded — hut become temple, and intertwined trees.
